name: living-codebase-brain
description: Marks methods you are changing that have been fixed before, using the Living Codebase Brain code graph.

commands.title: Check changes for past bug fixes

lcb.projectRoot.markdownDescription: Path to the Living Codebase Brain checkout (the folder containing `lcb/`). Empty: taken from `~/.lcb/config.json`, which `lcb setup` writes.

lcb.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python to run `lcb.check` with. Empty: the checkout's `.venv-mac` or `.venv`, else `python3`.

lcb.repo.markdownDescription: Git repository to check. Empty: each workspace folder.

lcb.minConfidence.description: How strong a link to a past fix must be before a method is marked.

lcb.severity.markdownDescription: How marked methods appear. `error` gives a red underline, `warning` a yellow one.

lcb.neo4jUri.markdownDescription: Code graph address. Empty: `NEO4J_URI` from the environment, else `bolt://localhost:7687`.
